claim: Patchline models the proof holes behind an uncertain risk as a dependency graph and computes the smallest, dependency-respecting set of evidence whose acquisition would lower the risk's uncertainty below a target, so that a reviewer is told the cheapest concrete way to make a finding trustworthy rather than a vague request for more information. The worker enumerates evidence subsets, keeps only those whose dependencies are satisfied and whose combined uncertainty reduction meets the target, and selects the minimum-cost feasible set. The gate proves the selected set reaches the target at minimum cost, respects evidence dependencies, and never includes an irrelevant zero-reduction item.
real_repo: patchline (self): minimal evidence selection over a proof-hole graph
